coordinates.map_m: x = east, y = north, z = metres above the hub's grade (F2 entrance floor = 0; F1 basement -6, F3 6, F4 12, F5 18, roof 24); origin = Century Tower
coordinates.game: X = (x - cx) * 100, Y = z * 100, Z = -(y - cy) * 100 with (cx, cy) = center_m; Y is the ray-cast collision floor (Mario's feet). Objects that hover (stars, coins) add their own offset.
coordinates.floor_m: collision floor measured by ray-casting the built level (1.5 m above the design height, straight down)

note: Anchor points for the Course 4 mission author (docs/game_design.md 7.3), measured on the built collision of levels/ccm. 'actN_' keys use the design act numbers (7.3: 1 Out-of-Order Elevator, 2 Quiet Floor, 3 Group Study Room Booking (co-op), 4 Lost Lab Notebook Pages = the 8 'lost textbook' red-coin spots, 5 Printer Jam, 6 Overdue Book Express); course act order is the mission author's (docs/flow.md 5.1: solo acts first, co-op last). Points with a 'check' key did not measure as designed. No level-script star: every mission spawns its own (spawn_default_star from the controller, star id act - 1).
